About this book

Petals in a Spin is a collection of forty original floral mandalas — circular patterns built from petals, leaves and small repeating shapes. Earlier pages keep things simple and bold; later ones spiral into finer, more intricate detail for whenever you want a slower, more absorbing project. There's no fixed order, so feel free to jump around and pick whatever suits your mood.

Forty original designs, each a full-page, single-sided pattern with a blank sheet behind it, in the same 8.5-inch square format as the rest of the collection.

Because it's printed by Amazon on demand, we can't promise the paper is marker-proof. Heavy alcohol-based markers may still show through, so we recommend slipping a spare sheet of paper behind whichever page you're working on, and testing a new pen in a corner first.

Questions about this book

Do the patterns get harder as the book goes on?

Roughly — earlier pages favor bigger, simpler petals, and later ones add finer detail. There's no fixed order, so feel free to jump around and pick whatever suits your mood.

Will marker or gel pen bleed through?

Pages are single-sided with a blank sheet behind each design, which helps, but we can't promise zero bleed-through with heavy alcohol-based markers. Slip a spare sheet of paper behind the page you're coloring and test new pens on a corner first.

Is it the same size as the other two books?

Yes — all three Craven & Quill books are the same 8.5 × 8.5 inch square format, so they sit neatly together on a shelf.
